_readme: The one news item shown at the top of the home page (home.html). Edit the fields and publish: title (short), text (one or two sentences), date (YYYY-MM-DD), image (path or URL, wide image works best), link + cta (where the button goes and what it says). Set "show": false to hide the banner.
title: Creative Dist 2.0 is out now
text: Flux joins Saturation, Noise, Bode Shifter and the EQ: morph between two of nine algorithms in real time. Free update for every license.
